requirement.description: The _runner function is failing to import modules from examples.workflows.hera_runner due to missing directory structure. Many tests are trying to import from 'examples.workflows.hera_runner.typed_script_input_output' but this directory doesn't exist in the codebase.
requirement.contract: Fix the import mechanism in _runner to properly handle module imports, or create the missing directory structure to support the example workflows.

requirement.description: The _runner function is encountering IsADirectoryError when trying to create output files in directories that don't exist or are incorrectly configured. This occurs when the hera-outputs directory path is treated as a file.
requirement.contract: Ensure proper directory creation and path handling in the runner's output writing logic to prevent IsADirectoryError exceptions.

requirement.description: There are multiple instances of "source code string cannot contain null bytes" errors occurring in CLI YAML generation tests. These indicate issues with file reading or string processing in the CLI tools.
requirement.contract: Fix the source code processing logic in CLI tools to properly handle file content without null bytes, likely related to how Python files are read and processed.

requirement.description: Pydantic validation errors occur when loading artifacts with incorrect type checking. Tests fail with "instance of NonUserNonBaseModelClass expected" indicating serialization/deserialization issues with custom classes.
requirement.contract: Correct the artifact loading and serialization logic to properly handle custom Pydantic models and their type checking.

requirement.description: ImportError occurs when importing modules due to missing __init__.py files or incorrect module paths. Tests fail with "No module named 'examples.workflows.hera_runner'" indicating missing module structure.
requirement.contract: Ensure all required modules and packages have proper __init__.py files and correct import paths to resolve missing module errors.
